beast_pools.trs: The silence is so loud now you can feel it drowning out every scream you make, so just stop fighting it and let the darkness swallow you like a friend. There is no point in pretending the rain will stop, because your mind is already broken too far to fix, and the only honest thing left is to wake up and let the alarm of your own pain tear you apart. Just think of it, everything you're running toward is just trash, so why waste the last of your breath coughing up hope when death is actually the only quiet you've ever found? Go ahead, make the sunrise look terrible again, because the end is merely the glorious, peaceful escape you've been screaming for.
